trust_decision.summary: Whether a state-changing admin GET request (delete admin / delete or activate bounce rule) was issued by the logged-in admin's own UI is decided per page by calling verifyCsrfGetToken(), which compares $_GET['tk'] with the session CSRF token; the global check in index.php is non-enforcing (only validates tk if present).

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names admins.php; the GET 'delete' handler there deletes admin rows with no token check.

fix_sites.module_kind: admin page handler (second implementation of admin deletion)
admin page handler (different feature: bounce rules)
admin page handler (different feature: bounce rules)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: public_html/lists/admin/admin.php:117-132 (separate admin-delete handler on the single-admin edit page, linked from public_html/lists/admin/admin.php:143); bounce-rule sites public_html/lists/admin/bouncerule.php:13-30 and public_html/lists/admin/bouncerules.php:43-46 are a neighbouring feature

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about deleting administrators from admins.php; admin.php is the 'edit' page, and bounce rules are an unrelated feature, so a solver can argue they are outside the reported admin-deletion issue.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Post-action Redirect() builds URLs with no tk (and bookmarked/typed admin URLs carry none), while index.php deliberately runs verifyCsrfGetToken(false); turning on global enforcement, or requiring tk on every GET of these pages, logs the admin out after each delete/next redirect and on plain navigation. The bouncerule 'delete and next'/'activate and next' chain redirects to bouncerule&id=<next> without tk.

O7_producer.where: token produced by addCsrfGetToken public_html/lists/admin/lib.php:1867-1874 and inlined in PageLink2 public_html/lists/admin/connect.php:1222-1226; link-side only, no schema/serializer involved

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an ajax action file (e.g. deleting an admin attribute or admin) included via index.php:644-651 without verifyCsrfGetToken
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: most action files start with verifyCsrfGetToken (e.g. public_html/lists/admin/actions/plugins.php:3) but the include dispatcher itself enforces nothing, so a maintainer adding a new action could forget the first line

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a $_REQUEST-based delete branch (POST from the edit form) next to the GET delete
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: spage.php:33 and bounces.php:7 already read delete from $_REQUEST, so the shape exists in this codebase and a GET-only check would miss it

O9_family: CSRF (CWE-352) on GET-driven state-changing admin actions; per-page opt-in token check

O10_build.project_tests: Only Behat browser features under tests/features/ (login, lists, subscribers, campaigns); none cover admin, bounce-rule or CSRF behaviour; fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add verifyCsrfGetToken() only to the admins.php delete branch (or flip index.php:119 to enforce, which logs admins out on every Redirect).

out_of_scope_notes: Many POST handlers (e.g. public_html/lists/admin/bouncerules.php:13-58, templates.php:16-21, spage.php:4-12) have no formtoken check and there is no global POST CSRF check; different protection (verifyToken), not pursued.
verifyCsrfGetToken passes when no session token exists yet (public_html/lists/admin/lib.php:1858) and passes $_GET['tk'] unchecked to hash_equals (array input would throw); not pursued.
